title: ERC-7730 Ledger overlay
description: Ledger extensions for the descriptors of one registry folder, kept out of the descriptors so that they stay plain ERC-7730 files. The file registry/<entity>/ledger.json applies to the calldata-*.json and eip712-*.json descriptors of registry/<entity>/. See specs/erc7730-ledger-profile.md.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, relative to registry/<entity>/ledger.json.

ledgerhq.description: The Ledger namespace. It holds every Ledger extension of the folder, so there is one thing to version.

version.description: Version of the Ledger namespace payload.

icon.description: Default icon of every descriptor of the folder.

descriptors.description: Per-descriptor exceptions to the folder defaults, keyed by descriptor file name.

icon.description: Icon of this descriptor, or null for no icon (network icon, as today).
Identifier of a dApp icon in LedgerHQ/ledger-network-icons (icons/dapps/dapp_<icon>_<size>px.gif). Shown in place of the network icon in the clear-signing flow of every function of the descriptor.
